title: Incapacious
summary: INCAPA'CIOUS, adjective [in and capacious.] Not capacious; not large or spacious; narrow; of small content; as an incapacious soul.

inlines.v: INCAPA'CIOUS, adjective [in and capacious.] Not capacious; not large or spacious; narrow; of small content; as an incapacious soul.
